QuestInfo.name: El Nath Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Jade is searching for something in order to prepare for winter. Go see Jade in El Nath.
QuestInfo.1: In order to stay warm during the winter, Jade in El Nath wants to get Tepid Lava from the Dead Mine. She says that Tepid Lava is a perfect heat source because it's cooler than normal lava.You can get the lava from the Dead Mine, but you might also find it on monsters who took it with them into the snowfield.
QuestInfo.2: Jade of El Nath asked you to gather Tepid Lava so she could keep warm.

0.0: Oh, isn't it so cold? Feels like my whole body is freezing. Soon all the villagers will start heading to the Dead Mine.\r\n#L0##bTo the Dead Mine? Why?#l\n#k
0.1: You don't know? El Nath is covered with so much snow you can't find any firewood. So we use the Lava that flows down from the Lava Cave to stay warm. The Lava that flows out of the Dead Mine or the Snowfield is perfect for keeping warm.\nLooks like you like adventures... Would you like to bring me some Lava? I'm sure you'll have fun.

yes.0: Great! You are quite adventurous! The monsters in the Dead Mines and at the Snowfield should have the lava. Good luck!\n\n#b#i4032565# #t4032565# x 20

no.0: Too troublesome? But it'll be fun! Please reconsider.
